segredos.instrucao: Create a token of its own with only Account › Workers Scripts › Edit and Account › Account Settings › Read, on the Zikaron account, and paste the value.
The Account ID of the Zikaron account (on the account's page, at the side).
The App ID of the zikaron GitHub App.
The number at the end of the address of the zikaron App's installation on the test vault.
https://<team>.cloudflareaccess.com, with no trailing slash.
Access › Applications › the zikaron-staging application › the Application Audience (AUD) Tag.
The JSON from docs/api.md, with the Client IDs of noah-teste, alan-teste and outro-teste, on one line.

https://zikaron-staging.<subdomain>.workers.dev, with no trailing slash: the account's workers.dev subdomain shows up under Workers & Pages. It has to exist before the first deploy, which does not publish without it.
Access › Service credentials › noah-teste: the Client ID.
Access › Service credentials › noah-teste: the Client Secret.
Access › Service credentials › alan-teste: the Client ID.
Access › Service credentials › alan-teste: the Client Secret.
Access › Service credentials › outro-teste: the Client ID.
Access › Service credentials › outro-teste: the Client Secret.
Fine-grained token with Contents: Read and write on the zikaron-cofre-teste repository only.

Create a token of production's own, with the same permissions as the staging token (Account › Workers Scripts › Edit and Account › Account Settings › Read), on the Zikaron account, and paste the value.
The Account ID of the Zikaron account (on the account's page, at the side).
The App ID of the production GitHub App, zikaron-producao (never the staging zikaron).
The number at the end of the address of the zikaron-producao App's installation on kelpie-vault. Only after Kelpie's context-store stops (docs/production.md).
https://<team>.cloudflareaccess.com, with no trailing slash.
Access › Applications › the zikaron (production) application › the Application Audience (AUD) Tag.
The JSON from docs/api.md, with the Client IDs of the noah, alan and mac service tokens and the flags of ADR-0001 §7, on one line.

https://zikaron.<subdomain>.workers.dev, with no trailing slash: the account's workers.dev subdomain shows up under Workers & Pages. It has to exist before the first release, which does not publish without it.
